Progress you can understand.

The impact dashboard separates estimates from recorded funding and local temperature studies. It does not turn every journey into an assumed environmental benefit.

Live and accumulated carbon

A shared ride qualifies only when its owner confirms they were already making the journey and the rider declares that their party would otherwise use one separate solo car. GPS segments recorded while that booking is in progress are multiplied by 0.249 kg CO₂ per kilometre. This is an illustrative US average petrol-car tailpipe proxy, not a measurement of Pune vehicles. It excludes fuel production, vehicle manufacture, extra detours and potential changes in consumption from carrying passengers.

One booking party counts as one avoided car, even when it reserves several seats. Car and Bike services, unknown alternative journeys, missing GPS and rejected GPS segments receive no savings claim. The estimate assumes the shared journey replaces the same-distance solo journey. It cannot prove that the counterfactual journey would have occurred.

Live totals are provisional; completed-journey totals accumulate for the lifetime view. Cancelled bookings are excluded. Older trips without measurements are not retrospectively assigned savings. Driver totals describe the impact enabled by their journeys and overlap rider totals; the overall dashboard counts each booking once.

Traffic hours

The dashboard reports estimated vehicle-hours avoided: the observed duration of eligible tracked shared segments, representing one solo car per qualifying booking party. It does not measure passenger time saved, road-network congestion or the causal effect of this app on Pune traffic. Estimating those effects needs a traffic study and a credible comparison scenario.

Tree contributions

Our pledge is 50% of annual net profit after tax, not 50% of each fare. Rider and owner contribution cards show recorded Green Fund allocations attributed by the operator to completed, paid journeys. They do not mean the person made a direct donation. Allocations and tree counts require unique evidence records. Zero means no allocations have been entered; it is not proof that planting or care has occurred.

Urban heat in °C

Carbon reductions cannot be converted directly into a city temperature reduction. Until a local study is recorded, the dashboard says Not measured. A recorded result compares the before/after temperature change at a project site with the change at a comparison site. Positive values indicate a reported cooling difference; negative values indicate a warming difference.

Results apply only to the named site, period and study conditions. Weather, shade, season, sensor placement and other changes can affect temperatures. A recorded difference is not proof that Planto-Ride alone caused it and cannot be extrapolated to the whole city.

Sources and limitations

The factor is based on the US EPA's approximate 400 g CO₂ per mile average passenger-vehicle figure, rounded to 0.249 kg/km. Read the EPA passenger-vehicle explanation. Local heat evidence needs site measurement and suitable controls; see the EPA guidance on measuring heat islands.

These are informational estimates and recorded programme data, not independently verified carbon credits or an environmental certification.
